title: Qualify bounded exact integer, combinatorics and arithmetic sequence package
commitMessage: feat: qualify exact integers combinatorics and finite sequences in Math scientific

contribution.summary: Qualify a new provider-neutral dw.tools.math.scientific net10 package for bounded exact BigInteger GCD/LCM, factorial, binomial and finite arithmetic-series sums. Recover one compiled API RED and pass 69 GREEN tests, three relevant Math regressions and eight independent NuGet-only oracles against a SHA-inspected local preview.1 archive. Complete C01-T1 only; preserve finite budgets, negative-input refusals and unqualified public/downstream adoption.
contribution.value: Expose exact reusable mathematical primitives with bounded operand/output bits and iteration budgets, explicit nonpartial refusals and no hidden binary64 approximations, unbounded resource guarantees or borrowed decision semantics.
debtChanges: Qualify new scientific project and test-project integration, exact solution paths and locked net10 package manifests; no empty published packages.
Observe one compiled missing-public-API RED with project skeleton before introducing GCD/LCM, factorial, binomial and arithmetic sequence algorithms.
Require 69 independent exact GREEN oracles for gcd(48,18)=6, lcm(6,8)=24, 0!=1, C(5,2)=10, finite arithmetic sums and meaningful negative tests.
Bound inputs, result bit lengths, factorial/binomial arguments, logical sequence count, Euclid loop steps and cancellation with typed nonpartial refusals.
Use BigInteger exact arithmetic only; no binary64 fallback, probabilistic primality claims, CAS provider or decision-domain ownership.
Verify three core retained Math regressions, actual BCL-only net10 preview.1 package identity/SHA and eight independent source-free consumer oracles.
Finish only C01-T1 RED/GREEN/V and T1. Leave C01 T2, M6-W02, M6, stable/public NuGet and external consumer adoption unqualified.
contribution.nextAction: After RS088 durable success, prepare M6-W02-C01-T2 to independently qualify signed input boundaries, numerical growth limits and integer budgets; leave C01, M6-W02 and M6 open.
